notes.title: Version 1.0 Released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39928294/1f57b7d201f347178e31ef65924aedfa3a1f54f1.gif[/img]

[b]Entity Researchers[/b] is finally out of Early Access! 
Feels great to get this far and I couldn't have done it without all the people that have supported the game so far so thank you!
As a mostly procedurally-generated game it can be extremely hard to find bugs and I would never have been able to find and fix even a fraction of the problems; but thanks to everyone's input the game has been running well for a while so once again thanks!

Here's some things that have changed during the Early Access period, this list mostly covers new features and major changes...

[b]Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Affinity menu
[*] Bounty casefiles
[*] Critical Bonus round
[*] Daily lottery
[*] Damage balancing
[*] Elite entities
[*] Entity scaling
[*] Entity status caps
[*] Entity variance
[*] ERX-Pass for hardcore players
[*] Extended Player objectives line
[*] Field modifiers
[*] Generator item
[*] Improved Map generation
[*] Improved Map movement
[*] Inventory sorting
[*] Item Equip shortcuts
[*] Item Refine shortcuts
[*] Map Terminals
[*] New Achievements
[*] New Job objectives
[*] New NPCs
[*] New Unique Item modifiers
[*] Optional Tutorial
[*] Right-click sell items
[*] Sensitivity options
[*] XP Balance
[/list]Enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39928294/29ee914c96e5b22fdcdf1d427549ffbe7063af59.gif[/img]

Savefiles from Version 0.16+ should work without issue though a New Game is recommended.
Previous updates provide more detailed notes regarding each fix and addition, to find out more please refer to individual announcements.
If you find any bugs please let me know and I will aim to fix them as soon as possible.

notes.title: Entity Researchers Version 0.9
notes.content:
New random Job objective with Unique item rewards so grab more sweet loot.
New NPC Merchant selling discounted items.
Some doors will now be locked, keys found throughout level.
New Unique modifiers rolling on Rares and greater.
ERX-Leg Mods now increase Movement Speed.

[b]Notes:[/b]
New Job objective with Uniques
Asgald the NPC
Locked doors
ERX-Legs affect Movement Speed
Greater wall transparency
New Unique modifiers:
[list][*] Movement Speed
[*] Turn Time
[*] XP Up
[*] Res Up
[*] Affinity XP Up[/list]
